name: doc-upload-extraction
description: Document upload and extraction application with NestJS backend and React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/dist frontend/dist
